lines.en: I make my way through the late night smog of the urban district and wind up inside one of the worst places in Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: 我穿过城区深夜的烟雾，最后走进了 Kumon-mi 最糟糕的地方之一。

lines.en: Yasu greets me with outstretched arms, as if wanting to embrace me.
lines.zh: Yasu 张开双臂迎接我，像是想拥抱我。

lines.en: But the second I move closer to her, she jumps back and begins to laugh maniacally.
lines.zh: 可我一靠近，她就跳了回去，开始疯笑起来。

lines.en: Apparently, she does not feel the presence or the warmth of her god tonight, so physical contact is strictly forbidden.
lines.zh: 看来她今晚感受不到她的神的存在与温暖，所以身体接触是绝对禁止的。

lines.en: I'm not really sure what I was expecting, to be totally honest. But I'm not really all that fond of hugging anyway.
lines.zh: 说实话，我也不太确定自己本来在期待什么。反正我也不是特别喜欢拥抱。

lines.en: If the two of us are going to touch, I'd prefer it to be as loveless and passionately violent as possible.
lines.zh: 如果我们俩非要接触，我倒希望它尽可能没有爱意、只有激烈的暴力。

lines.en: There is no place for {s}God{/s} god in my relationship with her, despite what she both wants and believes.
lines.zh: 在我和她之间的关系里，{s}上帝{/s} 神没有立足之地——无论她多么想要、多么相信。

lines.en: But still, I continue to sate her appetite to be heard and swallow each and every faithful lie she spits out at me.
lines.zh: 但我还是继续满足她「想被听见」的胃口，把她吐给我的每一句虔诚的谎言都咽下去。

lines.en: I'm a little upset that this includes hugging, but I still feel kind of weird about hugging Yasu anyway...so I guess it's okay.
lines.zh: 其中也包括拥抱，这让我有点不爽，不过我本来就对抱 Yasu 这件事感觉怪怪的……所以也算还行。
